## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 2-fascicle text by [王日休](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%8B%E6%97%A5%E4%BC%91) Wáng Rìxiū (d. 1173) is the famous Southern-Sòng *composite recension* of the *Larger Sukhāvatīvyūhasūtra*, synthesised from the four major existing Chinese translations ([T0360](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0060), [T0361](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0061), [T0362](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0062), [T0363](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0063)). The result is a unified Chinese Pure Land scripture that combines what Wáng Rìxiū judged to be the best readings from each of the source-translations, producing a stylistically polished and devotionally accessible text. The work became one of the most widely-chanted versions of the *Sukhāvatīvyūha* in late-imperial Chinese Pure Land practice.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1160 – 1173) reflects [王日休](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%8B%E6%97%A5%E4%BC%91) Wáng Rìxiū's mature Buddhist period leading up to his death.

The Taishō text (T0364) is established on the standard apparatus.
